data.one_liner: Moon Design System icon collection for Flutter applications
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of modern icons from the Moon Design System as a Flutter package. Allows developers to easily use icons via the MoonIcons class with specified sizes and variants.
use_when: You are building an app using the Moon Design System
You need a modern and consistent set of UI icons
avoid_when: You prefer a different icon library like Material or Cupertino
You only need a couple of standard system icons
strengths: Easy integration with standard Flutter Icon widgets
weaknesses: Limited to the Moon Design System icon set
Not documented with a complete built-in icon gallery on pub.dev (requires checking example repo)
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import moon_icons/moon_icons.dart.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a vast and well-known selection of vector icons instead of the Moon Design System.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the clean and consistent look of Lucide icons.
